detail.longDescription: Please don't direct me to the millions of existing posts explaining the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent . I understand exactly what both functions do. Existing sources say that you would use encodeUri when you already have a URI that is structurally correct but might have characters that need to be URI encoded. Since a URI that is not properly URL encoded is not a valid URL, surely in that case what you have is a bug in whichever component generated that URL, and the only sensible way to proceed is identify the exact nature of the bug and either fix it, or deconstruct the URL (using the reverse of the buggy logic used to build it) and then reconstruct it properly. Can anyone identify a realistic scenario where one component should build a URL without URL encoding certain parts of it, and then another component would URL encode it?
